- 1 tbsp of butter

5. Pour the whipped cream mixture into the pie crust.
6. Arrange the strawberry slices on top of the whipped cream.
7. Bake the pie for about 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
8. Remove from the oven and let it cool for about 15 minutes before serving.
